newsitem.title: CHINA: Explosion rocks Beijing chemical factory.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rocks Beijing chemical factory.

text.p: A large explosion rocked a chemical factory in a suburb of the Chinese capital Beijing late on Friday but there were no reports of deaths, local government and hospital officials said.

"It was a big explosion," one local official said, adding that the blast occurred at the Dongfang Chemical Factory shortly after 8 p.m. (1200 GMT). "Many fire engines went to the factory... officials are there now."
Eyewitnesses said flames and smoke continued to pour out of the factory several hours after the explosion.
"No one was killed. Most of the injured are only slightly injured," said an official at the nearby Luhe Hospital.
Staff at the factory in Tong county declined to comment on the blast.
"Nothing is clear at the moment," said one factory worker.
Several ambulances were seen driving away from the burning factory while fire engines surrounded the building.
